fem.text: Reod Dai arranges a trade deal between the Ebon Hand and Havenwood that creates thallids, and is hired by the Elder Druids to distract Icatia, so he forms a truce between goblins and orcs of the Crimson Peaks to harass it.
His dispute with Melelki over dragon eggs destroys the dwarves' house, and his seduction spell on Tamun backfires so that they fall in love.

Reod is captured by the elves and escapes with Andli's help, then betrays Genkr Nik by starting a thrull rebellion, and he convinces thrulls to turn on their masters, who annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids.

Reaching besieged Gurn Keep, he is imprisoned by suspicious dwarves, and without his direction the keep falls to the goblins, and later he finds Melelki and Tamun as Sekena's dragon carries them away.
